definition: a flower on a tree, like cherry blossom
description: A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er niest unter einem blühenden Baum.
phrases: den Kopf in den Nacken werfen
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está estornudando bajo un árbol en flor.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il éternue sous un arbre en fleurs.
